question: T12 (task-223c1bdf55dcde09): on the desktop, a Text Size fall (Medium to Small) with a Text block that starts between the Scrolling block's top and its new foot: does it stay, and what rows does the Scrolling block take? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10); Small is the Text Size as added. 'open' selects the Scrolling block, Edit, Design; 'go' is Escape and a press on the page; 'place 1 r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes the Text block by hand. N4: open, Medium, go, place the Text block at 2/2/12/10, open, Small, go, Cmd+Z until as built; N5 the same with a press on Wave Intensity 30 first, N6 with 60 first. R1 and R2 are two clean rounds of the three plans in one session (the lane's R2 session, probe-w.mjs, plans N4 to N6 and then again as N4b to N6b, stored here as N4 to N6 under R2). Exit without saving.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, the range's value). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built).
answer: The Text block that starts on the Scrolling block's second row stays at 2/2/12/10 on each fall, while the foot comes up to or above its top; the section keeps 11 rows.

N4, Wave 0: Medium takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/4/26 (block 112.3) and the Text block as added to 2/2/4/10; placed at 2/2/12/10, Small takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/2/26 (block 34, a fall of 78 px).
N5, Wave 30: Medium 1/2/5/26 (block 153.4); Small 1/2/3/26 (block 71.2, a fall of 82 px).
N6, Wave 60: Medium 1/2/5/26 (block 153.4); Small 1/2/3/26, the block 94 high, its line running over the 2 rows (a fall of 59 px, under 60).

Escape keeps every area; Cmd+Z takes back Small (the Scrolling block's rows before it, the Text block where it was), then the place and the earlier steps one by one. R1 and R2 read alike in every read (areas, rows, block, line, Undo and Redo).
Not read: a Text Size fall under 41 px (one row), Large to Medium with a block between, the phone view, a block that starts below the new foot on a Text Size fall (CAP-T12SHORTFALL IB has one on it).
